eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Morgan, CO; at 5:27 AM on AUG 21, 2022 Effective until 6:57 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
There is a Law enforcement emergency in the area of I-76 and Hwy 6. Three suspects are in the area and may be armed.  Please lock your vehicles and homes. Shelter In Place.  Do Not pickup hitchhikers or pedestrians.  

A follow up alert will be sent once this emergency is over
